strategy_a_context_free_trie.permission_condition: A later tokenizer audit proves exact decoded-suffix compositionality for every admitted token and every relevant decoder context.
strategy_a_context_free_trie.prohibited_assumption: A token's standalone decoded piece is always the suffix produced after an arbitrary token prefix.
strategy_a_context_free_trie.operation: Traverse token-piece characters through the approved character controller and admit the token only after the entire piece is accepted.

strategy_b_prefix_sensitive_full_decode.trigger: Use whenever suffix compositionality is unproven or false for any relevant tokenizer or decoder class.
strategy_b_prefix_sensitive_full_decode.operation: Decode the complete candidate token prefix, derive or rebuild the complete character-controller state from its decoded bytes/text, and admit only an exact valid prefix.
strategy_b_prefix_sensitive_full_decode.cache_constraint: No state-only or standalone-token-piece cache may be used where decoding is prefix-sensitive.

token_admission_contract.rule: A candidate token is allowed only when its complete decoded effect leaves the request-bound V2 ledger language at a valid prefix and preserves a terminal or continuable path.
token_admission_contract.finite_modes: Literal, enum, punctuation, reference-hash, and numeric modes may use trie pruning, but acceptance still requires simulation of the complete decoded effect.
token_admission_contract.json_string_body: Structured JSON-string modes may prune impossible first characters, but must process every decoded character, including escapes and string-closing transitions.
token_admission_contract.eos: EOS is allowed only when the character controller is terminal and all construction obligations are discharged.
token_admission_contract.special_tokens: All non-EOS special/control tokens are excluded unless a later audited tokenizer contract assigns an explicit harmless decoding and the design is separately amended.
token_admission_contract.empty_decoding: Empty-decoding tokens are excluded by default because they do not advance character-language liveness.
token_admission_contract.semantic_boundary: Projection proves syntactic construction obligations only. Schema and semantic validation remain independent fail-closed checks.

cache_identity_requirements: exact character-controller state including reference substate and offsets
decoded-prefix or token-prefix identity whenever decoding is context-sensitive
cache_prohibitions: Do not canonicalize away source hashes, reference offsets, numeric ranges, or construction-obligation state.
Do not reuse generic JSON-string caches across request identities when reference legality depends on immutable input bytes.
Do not cache a context-free token suffix until the compatibility audit has proven that class context-free.

liveness_receipts.distinction: A character-language state may be live while the tokenizer has no token whose complete decoded effect follows a live edge; receipts must distinguish these conditions.

known_nonblocking_residual.issue: Some free semantic strings are bounded by the ledger schema more tightly than the character controller's global length ceiling.
known_nonblocking_residual.disposition: The schema remains a fail-closed postcondition. Projector-level mirroring of every field bound requires separate authorization and is not granted by this design.
